name: Mayor Match: City Builder & Match-3
description:
About This Game

Ready to build the metropolis of your dreams? Become the Mayor in a unique game that blends thrilling match-3 puzzles with strategic city building! Turn a small plot of land into a thriving paradise. Whether you envision a cozy town with leafy parks or a sleek skyline full of skyscrapers, the power is in your hands. Solve puzzles, earn resources and create the ultimate living space for your citizens!

• MASTER MASS TRANSIT
Keep your city moving! Set up efficient transport networks to deliver goods to stores and get residents to work, school or the cinema. Build a cutting-edge airport to boost mobility and welcome visitors.
• UNLOCK WORLD LANDMARKS
Turn your city into a global destination. Reconstruct famous wonders like the Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Coliseum and Sydney Opera — all in one place — to attract tourists.
• GO GREEN
Build a city of the future! Manage the environment by recycling waste, planting trees and upgrading buildings to be eco-friendly. Create a healthy, green paradise for your residents.
• MATCH & BUILD
Solve dynamic match-3 puzzles and transform an empty field into a bustling city complete with housing, urban farms, industrial zones and shopping malls.

While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.


You can play this game even if you’re offline!

Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Korean, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish.
